Turn every journey into an adventure with MINI Finance. Right now, enjoy a 4.99% p.a. comparison rate across the MINI range with a MINI Flex loan agreement. By making a larger deposit, you’ll unlock a more competitive rate, helping you save while experiencing MINI’s legendary go-kart handling.
